scope: Registration and reading of user-supplied sources (German, Finnish, Scandinavian, Latvian, Estonian) plus the archive.org Deutsches Namenbuch; reviewed histories from Balode 2024 and Kallasmaa 2010.

outcomes.LV-OL6-BALODE2024: Productive: 18 LV histories (rare-name classes, one bearer in 2022).
outcomes.EE-HIIUMAA-KN: Productive for Pent; Kärdi lead kept for hypotheses.
outcomes.FI-NAMES-IN-FOCUS: Hypothesis leads only (Leivo, Lehto, Tapper, Iiris); see var/namedays-research/leads137.json.
outcomes.FI-UH12-PNS: Hypothesis leads only (Karelian Madro, Iivo, Arto; Kauri).
outcomes.DE-JOCHUM2015: Early-medieval rare Germanic names; no open calendar names.
outcomes.DE-VILMAR-NB7: Family-name book in Fraktur with poor OCR; not usable.
outcomes.DE-HDV-SKIZZE: Scanned without a text layer (14 pages); not OCRed.
outcomes.DE-ARCHIVE-BREC: archive.org deutschesnamenbu00brec full text: Fraktur OCR is garbled; not usable as text.
outcomes.EE-VI-TOIM30: Same file as LOCAL-ROUND20-VORU, already read in round 20 (EE-SAAR16).
outcomes.slovar_russkih_lichnyh_imen.zip: Extracted with scripts/djvu-text.mjs (pure JavaScript DjVu text-layer decoder) and registered as RU-PETROVSKY-SRLI; candidates in var/namedays-research/petrovsky137.json, not yet written.
